page: Amazon Web Services r9g.4xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by AWS Graviton Arm64 processors. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs running at 3.3 GHz, with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. It has a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or parallel computing workloads. Additionally, the Arm64 architecture requires compatible software builds, which represents a tradeoff compared to traditional x86-64 environments.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the Graviton-based Arm64 architecture offers high resource density and power efficiency per core compared to x86 alternatives. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance appropriate for memory-intensive workloads such as open-source databases, in-memory caching layers, real-time data processing, and enterprise applications that require a large memory footprint relative to compute capacity.
